description: This Ruby script analyzes Android application resource files and source code to identify unused resources such as layout IDs and string IDs within a given directory structure. It traverses resource directories, parses XML and Java files, and reports unused identifiers in plain text or HTML format.

classes.name: UnusedResources
classes.description: Holds information about unused layout and string IDs for a particular app directory.

classes.name: FilePosition
classes.description: Represents a specific location within a file, including filename and line number.

methods.name: findAllOccurrences
methods.description: Finds all matches of a regular expression in a given string and returns the list of captured groups.

methods.name: recordJavaUses
methods.description: Analyzes Java files matching a glob pattern and records the usage of specific resource-related identifiers.

methods.name: findResDirectories
methods.description: Recursively finds all 'res' directories under the specified root directory.

methods.name: findUnusedResources
methods.description: Main function that computes unused resource IDs in a given Android project directory.

methods.name: findApps
methods.description: Finds all application directories containing 'res' folders under a specified directory.

methods.name: displayText
methods.description: Outputs the list of unused resources in plain text format.

methods.name: displayHtmlUnused
methods.description: Outputs unused resource IDs as an HTML table.

methods.name: displayHtml
methods.description: Generates an overall HTML report of unused resources across all analyzed apps.
